quote:

reason: The primary replication report explicitly states that 39 undergraduates were recruited and the final analytic sample after exclusions consisted of 23 participants with complete data (matching the repeated-measures interaction denominator df = 22); shipped erroneously recorded the pre-exclusion recruited count (39).

location: Canonical page 5, Deviation from initial analysis plan; page 6, Effect of Interest
quote:
The effect in this left amygdala ROI replicated the
original interaction between condition and rating type, F(1, 22) =6.44, p<.02, np2 = .226
reason: Two non-equivalent issues prevent determination: (1) the requested metric is eta-squared (etasq), whereas the report prints partial eta-squared (np2 = .226) for a 2x2 repeated-measures GLM where eta-squared and partial eta-squared are not equivalent and sum-of-squares components are unreported (not_comparable); and (2) the supplied text is the OSF RPP report rather than the cited 2017 Psychological Science article (10.1177/0956797617719730) from which shipped's 0.313 was taken.
